Title: Supreme Idly Podi
Body (HTML):
Supreme Idly Podi is our signature creation and the hero of House of Kumaran — a bold, aromatic, and authentically crafted South Indian spice blend made using time-honoured home-style roasting methods. Prepared with premium lentils, sun-dried red chillies, fresh curry leaves, and a touch of traditional sesame, this podi delivers a rich, nutty flavour with a warm, balanced heat.

Every spoonful carries the essence of Tamil household kitchens, where idli podi has been a daily staple for generations. Whether you're new to podi or already a fan, our Supreme Idly Podi brings a depth of taste that lifts even the simplest idli or dosa into a gourmet experience.

Direction of Use

  • Mix 1–2 teaspoons of podi with sesame oil or ghee and enjoy with hot idlis, dosas, uttapams, or paniyaram
  • Sprinkle over ghee rice, curd rice, or upma for an instant flavour boost
  • Use as a seasoning for roasted vegetables, chips, fries, or even popcorn
